'''Anthony Nowak''' is a Star Wars CCG player. They finished 10th in [[DecipherCon 1999 Progressive Sealed Deck]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]<ref name="dc99sw22_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Progressive Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001101003044/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>.
